headline: Chiefs stay in control
what_happened: P.Mahomes passed the ball to R.Rice for a short 6-yard gain on third down.
who: P.Mahomes threw the pass to R.Rice.
why_it_matters: Since they didn't get enough yards for a first down, the Chiefs are still leading by 4 points. They will likely choose to kick a field goal now, which is a kick through the goalposts worth 3 points.
